# Clean turn-taking room audio fixture

This bundle is a four-second, privacy-safe synthetic baseline. It has two
participants, two non-empty turns per participant, mono signed little-endian
PCM16 at 1000 Hz, peer received streams delayed by 20 ms, and a room mix.
The output WAV PCM payload is split into four timestamped delta records per
participant. `run-manifest.json` contains the format, identities, annotations,
fully expanded suite tolerances, provenance, and SHA-256/byte-size metadata for
every replay artifact.

No provider, microphone, credential, or private recording is used. Samples are
generated by a fixed seeded pseudo-speech function. The only transformations
are the fixed downsampled format, four-second trim, deterministic peer delay,
and delta chunking. Consent review is therefore not applicable; the manifest's
provenance section records the same decision for tooling that reads metadata.

Refresh the committed bundle from the repository root with:

```sh
go run ./agent-cli/internal/services/testdata/room-audio/generate.go --output agent-cli/internal/services/testdata/room-audio/clean-turn-taking
```

Verify it offline with:

```sh
go test ./agent-cli/internal/services -run 'TestCleanTurnTakingRoomReplay' -count=1
```

Normal tests only read this directory. Refreshing it is intentional and should
include the resulting artifact and manifest hash diff in review.
